BiblicalUsage: Chanok is a name carried by three men, and the greatest of them is Enoch the son of Jared, who walked with God and was not, for God took him. Another is Enoch the son of Cain, for whom Cain named the first city. The third is Hanoch the son of Reuben, counted among the heads of Israel's families in Egypt.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three must be kept apart, because only one walked with God and was taken: the son of Cain got a city named for him, and the son of Reuben got a clan, but Enoch the son of Jared got God Himself. I hold that walking with God is the only distinction that finally matters.
